chunks.subject: AP Human Geography
chunks.title: Q2 One Stimulus (7 points) — Set 1: population pyramid & urbanization
chunks.content: AP Human Geography FRQ 2 (One Stimulus, here a population pyramid), 7 points, parts A–G, one each, escalating skill (identify from the stimulus → describe → explain → explain a degree). Set 1 answer key by part: A [1] identify the recent fertility trend shown in the pyramid; B [1] describe a process that drives urbanization; C [1] explain the degree to which a country's population growth rate may be affected by a factor; later parts continue with explain-level demographic/urban tasks. Common failure: A misreading the pyramid trend; explain-level parts that describe rather than give a how/why mechanism or fail to address 'the degree to which.'

chunks.subject: AP Human Geography
chunks.title: Q2 Set 1 exemplar — Sample 2A, 7/7
chunks.content: Q2 (Set 1) scored 7/7 — read the fertility trend from the pyramid, described an urbanization process, and gave valid degree/mechanism explanations across the remaining parts. Full-credit model for the stimulus-based FRQ.

chunks.subject: AP Human Geography
chunks.title: Q2 Set 1 exemplar — Sample 2B, 6/7
chunks.content: Q2 (Set 1) scored 6/7 — earned six parts, missing one explain-level point, commonly the 'explain the degree to which' task that requires weighing a relationship rather than asserting it. Illustrates a strong response one point short on a degree/explain task.

chunks.subject: AP Human Geography
chunks.title: Q2 Set 1 exemplar — Sample 2C, 4/7
chunks.content: Q2 (Set 1) scored 4/7 — earned the stimulus-reading and describe parts plus one explain part, losing the higher explain/degree parts. Illustrates a mid response that reads the pyramid and describes processes but struggles with mechanism-level explanation.
